kurz: Toast whole spices briefly in a dry pan. They smell stronger and taste deeper.
bild_im_kopf: Like roasting coffee beans in miniature.
was_passiert: Heat releases volatile scent compounds and creates new roasted aromas. Because spices are small and dry, they burn quickly.
schritte: Put whole spices in a dry pan.
Toss over medium heat for 1–3 minutes.
As soon as they smell fragrant, take them out immediately.
